name: Quicken / weapon-activation-trigger-timing
notes: Guardian Bravo activates Sledge of Anvilheim for four floating resources and one AP. Quicken triggers from activating a weapon attack: Stack2/Arena1, no early grant. Trigger destroys token and grants go again before weapon attack resolves. Sledge printed6 deals6, opponent14 and AP1 at resolution. This covers the weapon-activation trigger independently from an attack action card.
